notes: Conditional strategy templates (no model predicts anything). Each template is a spec compiled by src/ml/ta_strategy/strategy.py: entry conditions are ANDed, each side fires on the bar its conditions turn true, and exits combine a stop, a target, trailing, signal exits, a time stop and the session-end flatten. {"param": name} values are tuned by Optuna inside the training span of each walk-forward fold (src/ml/ta_strategy/optimize.py); 'params' gives each search space (quantized so a neighbouring value exists). 'gate' is the session window the matched random-entry null is drawn from. Reference: docs/ta-strategy-600-ticks.md. A template may carry 'constraints' overriding the round's (the runner variants lift the session-end cap because they are designed to hold to the close; they are reported as NOT 2:1 brackets).

rsi_signal_macd_vwap.description: RSI crosses above its own signal line (an SMA of RSI) and the MACD histogram crosses above zero within the same few bars, with price above the session VWAP, in regular hours. Short is the mirror. Exits: ATR stop, 2R target, a time stop, the session end.

level_breakout_momentum.description: Close breaks through a multi-timeframe resistance zone (as it stood on the previous bar) whose confluence is at least N source families, with RSI above a momentum threshold, in regular hours. Short: breaks below support, RSI below 100 minus the threshold. Exits: stop beyond the BROKEN level plus an ATR buffer (risk capped at 500 ticks), 2R target, breakeven after a tuned R, the session end.

breakout_retest.description: A close through resistance, then within k bars a bar comes back within a tolerance of the broken level (as it was at the break) and closes beyond it again, with the MACD histogram above zero, in regular hours. Short is the mirror at support. Exits: stop beyond the retested zone plus a buffer, 2R target, a time stop, the session end.

higher_timeframe_trend_pullback.description: The 1h trend is up (1h EMA fast above 1h EMA 200, from the last completed hour), 15m RSI(14) crosses back up through a pullback level, and the MACD histogram is rising, in regular hours. Short is the mirror. Exits: ATR stop, 2R target, a chandelier trailing stop, the session end.

level_breakout_momentum_runner.description: Same entries as level_breakout_momentum; exit variant (not a 2:1 bracket): no target, stop to breakeven after 1R, hold to the session end.

opening_range_breakout.description: After 07:00 Pacific, close breaks the 06:30-07:00 opening-range high with RSI above a threshold and price above the session VWAP. Short is the mirror at the opening-range low. Exits: ATR stop, 2R target, a time stop, the session end.

opening_range_breakout_runner.description: Same entries as opening_range_breakout; exit variant (not a 2:1 bracket): no target, stop to breakeven after 1R, hold to the session end.

momentum_expansion_control.description: Level-free control for the breakout templates: a 15m bar that moves at least a tuned multiple of ATR in the trade direction, with RSI beyond a threshold and the MACD histogram on the same side of zero, in 06:30-10:30. Exits: ATR stop, 2R target, breakeven after 1R, the session end. If this earns as much as the level templates, the levels add nothing.

seasonal_breakout_rth.description: Breakout of the last n bars in the regular hours (06:30-13:00 Pacific) session, taken only when the causal intraday profile says volatility is about to RISE (expected volatility of the next 30 minutes over the last 30 at least rise_ratio). The stop is stop_mult x the expected high-low range of the next 60 minutes (seasonal, not trailing ATR, so it is wide into the open and narrow into lunch); the target is target_r x the risk; the trade is closed at the next open once the profile says volatility is about to FALL (ratio below fall_ratio).

seasonal_fade_rth.description: Mean reversion to the session VWAP in the regular hours (06:30-13:00 Pacific) session, taken only in time buckets the causal profile marks as RANGING (expected 30-minute efficiency ratio at most efficiency_max) and when volatility is NOT about to rise (ratio of the next 30 minutes to the last 30 at most calm_ratio): price stretched from VWAP by stretch x the expected 30-minute range and RSI turning back through rsi_low (long) or 100 - rsi_low (short). Target: target_fraction of the way back to VWAP; stop: stop_mult x the expected 30-minute range; closed at the next open when volatility is due to rise (ratio at least 1.5).

atr_breakout_control_rth.description: CONTROL for seasonal_breakout_rth: the same n-bar breakout and RSI side filter in the same window, with a trailing-ATR stop and no seasonal condition or seasonal exit. The difference between the two is what accounting for the time-of-day volatility profile adds.

seasonal_breakout_eth.description: Breakout of the last n bars in the overnight (13:00-06:30 Pacific, wrapping midnight) session, taken only when the causal intraday profile says volatility is about to RISE (expected volatility of the next 30 minutes over the last 30 at least rise_ratio). The stop is stop_mult x the expected high-low range of the next 60 minutes (seasonal, not trailing ATR, so it is wide into the open and narrow into lunch); the target is target_r x the risk; the trade is closed at the next open once the profile says volatility is about to FALL (ratio below fall_ratio).

seasonal_fade_eth.description: Mean reversion to the session VWAP in the overnight (13:00-06:30 Pacific, wrapping midnight) session, taken only in time buckets the causal profile marks as RANGING (expected 30-minute efficiency ratio at most efficiency_max) and when volatility is NOT about to rise (ratio of the next 30 minutes to the last 30 at most calm_ratio): price stretched from VWAP by stretch x the expected 30-minute range and RSI turning back through rsi_low (long) or 100 - rsi_low (short). event_breakout_rth_open.description: Time-event breakout: the high/low of the first range_minutes after the regular-hours open (06:30 Pacific); a close through it within window_minutes of the event enters (RSI side filter). Stop = stop_mult x the expected 60-minute range from the causal profile (which already knows the event minute is volatile); target = target_r x risk; time stop after hold_bars 5-minute bars.

event_breakout_london_open.description: Time-event breakout: the high/low of the first range_minutes after the London open (08:00 London, 00:00 Pacific or 01:00 in the weeks the US and UK clocks differ); a close through it within window_minutes of the event enters (RSI side filter). Stop = stop_mult x the expected 60-minute range from the causal profile (which already knows the event minute is volatile); target = target_r x risk; time stop after hold_bars 5-minute bars.

event_breakout_us_data_0830.description: Time-event breakout: the high/low of the first range_minutes after the 08:30 ET data window (05:30 Pacific), on sessions with a scheduled 08:30 ET release only; a close through it within window_minutes of the event enters (RSI side filter). Stop = stop_mult x the expected 60-minute range from the causal profile (which already knows the event minute is volatile); target = target_r x risk; time stop after hold_bars 5-minute bars.

seasonal_momentum_rth.description: The confirmed momentum 2:1 entry (a bar moving at least move_atr x ATR with RSI beyond rsi_threshold and the MACD histogram on the same side) taken only when the causal intraday profile says volatility is about to RISE (next 30 minutes over last 30 at least rise_ratio), anywhere in regular hours. Stop = stop_mult x the expected 60-minute range; target 2R (a 2:1 bracket); breakeven after 1R; closed at the next open when volatility is about to FALL (ratio below fall_ratio).

momentum_two_to_one_control.description: CONTROL for seasonal_momentum_rth: the round-2 momentum template (momentum_expansion_control: ATR stop, 2R target, a TUNED breakeven after breakeven_r, its own 06:30-10:30 window) re-tuned in the same round on the same bars. Not the exact round-3 frozen spec, which had NO breakeven (exit_override trail null).

seasonal_level_breakout_rth.description: The confirmed level breakout (a close through the nearest multi-timeframe resistance/support zone of at least min_strength families, RSI beyond rsi_threshold) taken only into RISING expected volatility, anywhere in regular hours; the stop stays just beyond the broken level (stop_buffer_atr), the target is 2R, breakeven after 1.25R, and the trade is closed at the next open when volatility is about to FALL.

seasonal_momentum_flow_rth.description: The confirmed momentum 2:1 entry (a bar moving at least move_atr x ATR with RSI beyond rsi_threshold and the MACD histogram on the same side) taken only when the causal intraday profile says volatility is about to RISE (next 30 minutes over last 30 at least rise_ratio), anywhere in regular hours. Stop = stop_mult x the expected 60-minute range; target 2R (a 2:1 bracket); breakeven after 1R; closed at the next open when volatility is about to FALL (ratio below fall_ratio). ORDER-FLOW GATE: additionally requires the tick-rule order-flow imbalance of the last flow_minutes minutes, z-scored against its previous 500 bars, to be at least flow_min_z in the trade's direction (long) or at most -flow_min_z (short). Flow is read only before 2025-07-01.

cascade_trend.description: Multi-timeframe cascade trend: swing levels (Williams fractals) on 1m, 5m, 15m and 30m; a 1-minute close breaking the 1m resistance, then the 5m, then the 15m, then the 30m (each later level above the earlier, within window minutes) is an UP trend of that many stages; support breaks in the same order are a DOWN trend. Long at the bar the up cascade first reaches n_stages, short at n_stages down. Stop beyond the last broken 5m level (a buffer of stop_buffer_atr x ATR); target target_r x risk; breakeven after breakeven_r; closed at the next open when the OPPOSITE cascade reaches 2 stages; time stop after hold_bars 5-minute bars; flat at the session end; entries unlimited per session, one position at a time. Whole session (ETH + RTH).

Regular hours only.

VOLUME CONFIRMATION: the relative volume of the last volume_minutes minutes (over the causal time-of-day volume profile) at least volume_min, and its trend over the last 15 minutes at least volume_trend_min (rising). Whole session.

MOMENTUM CONFIRMATION: RSI(14) beyond rsi_threshold (100 - rsi_threshold for shorts), RSI above (below) its 5-bar signal line, and the MACD(12,26,9) histogram on the trade's side of zero. cascade_aligned_control.description: CONTROL for cascade_trend: the same rules, but the trend counts the timeframes whose LAST break points the same way regardless of order (aligned_up / aligned_down), so the difference is what the user's 1m-then-5m-then-15m-then-30m ORDER adds. Whole session.

cascade_bounce_1m.description: Cascade trend on 1-minute bars with the user's LEVEL-BOUNCE exit: enter when the up (down) cascade first reaches n_stages; the next resistance (support) zone above (below), built from the 5m/15m/30m swing levels, is the level; when price reaches it the trade is armed and closes with profit as soon as price bounces bounce_ticks off its running extreme (a trailing stop armed at the level). A level closer than min_room_r x the risk is skipped. Stop beyond the last broken 5m level; breakeven after breakeven_r; closed at the next open when the opposite cascade reaches 2 stages; time stop hold_bars bars; flat at the session end; unlimited entries, one position at a time. Whole session (ETH + RTH).

zone_bounce.description: Trade AT the multi-timeframe support/resistance zones (prior session/RTH/week levels, opening ranges, round numbers, 15m/1h/4h fractals, 5m/15m/30m swing levels, VWAP bands, merged per bar with strength = distinct families): long when a 5m bar's low touches the support zone (within tolerance_atr x ATR of its top) and the bar CLOSES back above it, at a zone of at least min_strength families; short is the mirror at resistance. Stop beyond the far edge of the zone (stop_buffer_atr); breakeven after breakeven_r; the trade is closed at the next open if a bar closes through the far edge; time stop hold_bars bars; flat at the session end; unlimited entries, one position at a time. Target target_r x risk. Whole session.

zone_bounce_swings_only.description: CONTROL for zone_bounce: the same touch-and-close-back entry and exits, but the zones are built from the 5m/15m/30m swing levels only (no session levels, round numbers, higher-timeframe fractals or VWAP): the difference is what the multi-timeframe map adds over recent swings. Run in a round whose level_source is 'cascade'.

zone_touch_unconfirmed.description: Trade AT the multi-timeframe support/resistance zones (prior session/RTH/week levels, opening ranges, round numbers, 15m/1h/4h fractals, 5m/15m/30m swing levels, VWAP bands, merged per bar with strength = distinct families): long when a 5m bar's low touches the support zone (within tolerance_atr x ATR of its top) (UNCONFIRMED: no close-back condition; the touch alone), at a zone of at least min_strength families; short is the mirror at resistance. Stop beyond the far edge of the zone (stop_buffer_atr); breakeven after breakeven_r; the trade is closed at the next open if a bar closes through the far edge; time stop hold_bars bars; flat at the session end; unlimited entries, one position at a time. Target target_r x risk. Whole session.

zone_break_control.description: CONTROL (sign convention): trade THROUGH the same multi-timeframe zones instead of at them: short when a 5m bar closes below the far edge of the support zone that was known at the previous bar's close (the zone of the bar before, since a zone is chosen around its own bar's close), at a zone of at least min_strength families; long is the mirror through resistance. Stop back beyond the zone's near edge (stop_buffer_atr); target target_r x risk; breakeven after breakeven_r; time stop hold_bars; flat at the session end; one position at a time. Whole session. Prior rounds found breakouts lose; this arm confirms the bounce arms are read with the right sign.

Target target_r x risk. HIGHER-TIMEFRAME ZONES ONLY: the zone must hold a 1h/4h fractal or a session/week level. Whole session.
